name: LLMHound P5: gateways and UIs with backends on different hosts
description: Gateways or frontends reporting a backend service attached to a different existing BloodHound host.
query:
MATCH (s:LLMHound_AIService)-[:LLMHound_UsesBackend]->(b:LLMHound_AIService)
MATCH (s)-[:LLMHound_ObservedAt]->(hs), (b)-[:LLMHound_ObservedAt]->(hb)
WHERE hs <> hb AND NOT hs:LLMHound_NetworkEndpoint AND NOT hb:LLMHound_NetworkEndpoint
RETURN s, hs, b, hb
LIMIT 100
